**Finding: compliant (LICENSE — Licence grant scope).**

The licence package sits at the **preferred** level, so no redline is warranted:

- **Affiliates** — § 13.1 grants to "Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on their behalf"; § 13.2 repeats Affiliate coverage for paid-up material. No written-notice gate is needed, so the fallback mechanic is unnecessary.
- **Contractors acting on Customer's behalf** — expressly named in § 13.1, and § 13.2 permits contractors to support paid-up material.
- **Perpetual / irrevocable paid-up licence** — § 13.2 ("perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid").
- **Subscription licence terminable only for uncured material breach** — § 13.3 bars revocation or suspension except during a material uncured payment or use breach affecting the licensed item, after notice and a cure opportunity.
- **Transferable to successors** — § 13.3 read with § 24.1, which allows assignment without Vendor consent to an Affiliate or a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition, or asset sale.

The revocable, non-transferable **Deliverable** licence in § 14.2 is an ownership/IP allocation point handled under the IP rule; I have not double-flagged it here, and § 14.3 in any event routes Vendor Technology embedded in Deliverables to the perpetual § 13.2 licence.
